mapper.select: SELECT * FROM project_submission WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND round_no=#{roundNo}
SELECT * FROM project_submission WHERE submitter_id=#{userId} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM project_submission WHERE project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY round_no
mapper.update: UPDATE project_submission SET status=#{status},closed_at=NOW() WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.project_id,s.round_no,s.seq,s.org_id,s.status,s.actor_id,s.opinion,s.started_at,s.acted_at, COALESCE(s.org_name,o.name) AS org_name,COALESCE(s.actor_name,u.display_name) AS actor_name FROM approval_step s JOIN organization o ON o.id=s.org_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=s.actor_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY s.round_no,s.seq
SELECT a.* FROM approval_assignee a JOIN approval_step s ON s.id=a.step_id WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY s.round_no,s.seq,a.user_id
SELECT * FROM approval_step WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND status='WAITING' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM approval_step n JOIN approval_assignee a ON a.step_id=n.id WHERE n.project_id=#{projectId} AND n.round_no=#{roundNo} AND n.started_at IS NOT NULL AND a.user_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM approval_assignee WHERE step_id=#{stepId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE approval_step SET status=#{status},actor_id=#{actorId},actor_name=#{actorName},opinion=#{opinion},acted_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE approval_assignee SET status=CASE WHEN user_id=#{userId} THEN #{status} ELSE 'CLOSED' END WHERE step_id=#{stepId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE approval_step SET status='PENDING',started_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{stepId} AND status='WAITING'
UPDATE approval_assignee SET status='PENDING' WHERE step_id=#{stepId} AND status='WAITING'

UPDATE approval_assignee a JOIN approval_step n ON n.id=a.step_id SET a.status='CANCELLED' WHERE n.project_id=#{projectId} AND n.round_no=#{roundNo} AND n.status IN ('WAITING','PENDING') AND a.status IN ('WAITING','PENDING')
UPDATE approval_step SET status='CANCELLED',acted_at=NOW() WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND round_no=#{roundNo} AND status IN ('WAITING','PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.project_id,e.round_no,e.step_id,e.actor_id,e.action,e.note,e.before_status,e.after_status, e.before_version,e.after_version,e.created_at,COALESCE(e.actor_name,u.display_name) AS actor_name FROM project_event e JOIN app_user u ON u.id=e.actor_id WHERE e.project_id=#{projectId} AND e.round_no=#{roundNo} ORDER BY e.id
